newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Explorers Index surges in week.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Explorers Index surges in week.

text.p: Stockbroker Eyres Reed Ltd said its Australian Explorers Index soared 135.8 or 4.27 percent last week. The All Ordinaries index firmed 0.22 percent.
Nov 29 Nov 22 pct 1 Month pct 1 Year pct
NOTE: The explorers index (base 500, March 1992) tracks the performance of 88 small capitalisation exploration companies.
The index surged again this week as "spec" fever swept through the market, Eyres Reed analyst Glen Colgan said in a commentary.
"The catalyst agains was the Gawler Craton in South Australia," he said. "Although most finished off their intra-week highs, all posted substantial share price gains."
Gains outnumbered falls by a ratio of more than four to three,
Helix Resources NL, at the centre of Gawler Craton attention, leaped anothe A$1.65 to A$3.35 after further good drill results.
The company took the opportunity to tarise A$13.65 million at A$3.25 a share.

Among other Gawler players, Equinox Resources NL rose 24 cents to 82 cents, Goldstream Mining NL rose 7.5 to 52, Grenfell Resources NL firmed 28 to 85 cents and Redfire Resources NL gained seven cents to 27.

Further good drill results were reported by Money Mining NL from its Granny Venn prospect in Western Australia and Alkane Exploration NL from its Peak Hill project in New South Wales. Money added 4.5 cents to 32.5 cents and Alkane gained 11 cents to 50 cents.
Other strong rises were recorded by Striker Resources NL, up 5.5 cents to 22 cents, Diamond Ventures NL, up 11 to 37, Ballarat Goldfields NL, up 1.6 to 7.8, and Tectonic Resources NL, up 2.5 to 12.5.
